spec_case: issue #579 (aliases of the CLI adapters), default adapter
description: A document `adapter:` that names an alias: the run default is the alias, with its own `env` and `timeout_seconds` (the run's `effective_settings.sources` says so), and its name is `meta.adapter`. `env` values never reach `effective_settings` in the saved state (they are redacted, the variable names stay).
